subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become a public channel plugin capability, or should the fix remain a bundled Telegram-owned/internal seam until another channel needs the contract?
rationale: The bug and implementation direction are credible, but exposing a durable plugin delivery contract requires maintainer intent that source inspection and tests cannot establish.

options.title: Accept Public Capability
options.body: Keep the generic capability and require contract coverage, current-main reconciliation, and exact-head Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Telegram-Internal First
options.body: Use a bundled internal seam now and defer the extension-facing SDK contract until another implementation validates the abstraction.

recommendation.title: Accept Public Capability
recommendation.body: Keep the generic capability and require contract coverage, current-main reconciliation, and exact-head Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history trail most strongly connects this person to both auto-reply delivery architecture and public channel capability boundaries.
